title: ForecasterRollup
description: Aggregate accuracy for a forecaster, recomputed from scores. Powers the (auth-gated) leaderboard.

sample_size.description: Number of resolved forecasts behind these stats.

direction_win_rate.description: Share of point forecasts with correct direction.

bias_score.description: Systematic lean: -1 fully dovish, +1 fully hawkish, 0 neutral.

quality_score.description: Composite accuracy in [0,1] blending rate-call win rate and indicator accuracy. Null if unranked.

star_rating.description: 1-5 stars derived from quality_score. Null until the significance gate (min resolved forecasts) is met.

indicator_accuracy.description: Separate accuracy track per economic indicator (inflation, unemployment). Independent from rate-call accuracy above.

avg_error_pp.description: Mean absolute error in percentage points.

bias_score.description: Signed lean: + = systematically over-predicts (runs hot), - = under-predicts (runs cold).
